kultivator.kehancuran_semua.title: Destruction Mode — everything at a glance
kultivator.kehancuran_semua.done_on: Destruction Mode: everything switched ON with one command. Your techniques, test casts and Titah decrees now really carve the world (undo: /kultivasi kehancuran pulihkan).
kultivator.kehancuran_semua.done_off: Destruction Mode: everything switched OFF. Your queued carves stopped.
kultivator.kehancuran_semua.note.permit_: You turned the server permission on (written to config/kultivator.json). "semua mati" turns it back off.
The server permission you turned on with "semua nyala" is off again.
The server permission stays on: %s still use their own Destruction Mode switch.
kultivator.kehancuran_semua.perm.can: [Turn everything on] turns it on too
kultivator.kehancuran_semua.perm.op: an operator must allow it first (/kultivasi kehancuran izin on or /kultivasi kehancuran semua nyala)
kultivator.kehancuran_semua.tests: Test casts carve (uji teknik / uji dampak / test Titah)
kultivator.kehancuran_semua.tests.detail: op test casts only; resets when you leave
kultivator.kehancuran_semua.titah.off: Titah is turned off on this server
kultivator.kehancuran_semua.realm.detail: techniques carve from Golden Core; Titah needs True Immortal
kultivator.kehancuran_semua.oath.detail: their own oath, not switched by this command (then release each disciple's red seal)
kultivator.kehancuran_semua.oath.hover: Opens the red Sumpah Kehancuran screen
kultivator.kehancuran_semua.still: Still never carved: within %s blocks of villagers, iron golems and vassal villages, %s of other players, the world spawn (at least %s), %s of respawn points, %s of Sect Halls and building sites, %s of formations, cave abodes, secret realms, and %s around yourself; nor while you sneak (Shift), duel, break through or face a heart demon.
kultivator.kehancuran_semua.button.on_ho: Permission (when you may), own switch, Total Destruction, Molten Crater, test casts and all four Titah decrees
kultivator.kehancuran_semua.button.off_h: Switches all of them off again
kultivator.kehancuran_semua.button.statu: Locks, limits, jobs and undo windows
kultivator.kehancuran_semua.button.resto: Puts back the blocks still inside the undo window
